segments.ja514:2.1: Dohaḷo me mahārāja, supinantenupajjhagā [nu’ paccagā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja514:2.3: Na so sulabharūpova, yādiso mama dohaḷo.
segments.ja514:3.1: Ye keci mānusā kāmā, idha lokasmi nandane;
segments.ja514:3.3: Sabbe te pacurā mayhaṃ, ahaṃ te dammi dohaḷaṃ.
segments.ja514:4.1: Luddā deva samāyantu, ye keci vijite tava;
segments.ja514:5.1: Ime te luddakā devi, katahatthā visāradā;
segments.ja514:5.3: Vanaññū ca migaññū ca, mamatthe [mama te (pī.)] cattajīvitā.
segments.ja514:6.3: Chabbisāṇaṃ gajaṃ setaṃ, addasaṃ supine ahaṃ;
segments.ja514:6.5: Tassa dantehi me attho, alābhe natthi jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja514:7.1: Na no pitūnaṃ na pitāmahānaṃ, diṭṭho suto kuñjaro chabbisāṇo;
segments.ja514:7.3: Yamaddasā supine rājaputtī, akkhāhi no yādiso hatthināgo.
segments.ja514:8.1: Disā catasso vidisā catasso, uddhaṃ adho dasa disā imāyo;
segments.ja514:8.3: Katamaṃ disaṃ tiṭṭhati nāgarājā, yamaddasā supine chabbisāṇaṃ.
segments.ja514:9.1: Ito ujuṃ uttariyaṃ disāyaṃ, atikkamma so sattagirī brahante;
segments.ja514:9.3: Suvaṇṇapasso nāma girī uḷāro, supupphito [sampupphito (syā.)] kimpurisānuciṇṇo.
segments.ja514:10.1: Āruyha selaṃ bhavanaṃ kinnarānaṃ, olokaya pabbatapādamūlaṃ;
segments.ja514:10.3: Atha dakkhasī meghasamānavaṇṇaṃ, nigrodharājaṃ atha sahassapādaṃ [poraṃ (ka.)]. Tatthacchatī kuñjaro chabbisāṇo, sabbaseto duppasaho parebhi; Rakkhanti naṃ aṭṭhasahassanāgā, īsādantā vātajavappahārino. Tiṭṭhanti te tumūlaṃ [tumūla (syā.), bhimūla (pī. ka.)] passasantā, kuppanti vātassapi eritassa; Manussabhūtaṃ pana tattha disvā, bhasmaṃ kareyyuṃ nāssa rajopi tassa. Bahū hime rājakulamhi santi, piḷandhanā jātarūpassa devī; Muttāmaṇīveḷuriyāmayā ca, kiṃ kāhasi dantapiḷandhanena; Māretukāmā kuñjaraṃ chabbisāṇaṃ, udāhu ghātessasi luddaputte. Sā issitā dukkhitā casmi ludda, uddhañca sussāmi anussarantī; Karohi me luddaka etamatthaṃ, dassāmi te gāmavarāni pañca. Katthacchatī katthamupeti ṭhānaṃ, vīthissa kā nhāna [nahāna (sī. pī.)] gatassa hoti; Kathañhi so nhāyati [nahāyati (sī. pī.)] nāgarājā, kathaṃ vijānemu gatiṃ gajassa. Tattheva sā pokkharaṇī adūre [avidūre (syā. ka.)], rammā sutitthā ca mahodikā [mahodakā (syā. ka.)] ca; Sampupphitā bhamaragaṇānuciṇṇā [kiṇṇā (katthaci)], ettha hi so nhāyati nāgarājā. Sīsaṃ nahātuppala [nahāto uppala (sī. syā. pī.)] mālabhārī, sabbaseto puṇḍarīkattacaṅgī; Āmodamāno gacchati sanniketaṃ, purakkhatvā mahesiṃ sabbabhaddaṃ. Tattheva so uggahetvāna vākyaṃ, ādāya tūṇiñca dhanuñca luddo; Vituriyati [vituriya so (sī. aṭṭha.)] sattagirī brahante, suvaṇṇapassaṃ nāma giriṃ uḷāraṃ. Āruyha selaṃ bhavanaṃ kinnarānaṃ, olokayī pabbatapādamūlaṃ;
segments.ja514:11.1: Tatthaddasā kuñjaraṃ chabbisāṇaṃ, sabbasetaṃ duppasahaṃ parebhi;
segments.ja514:21.1: Tatthaddasā pokkharaṇiṃ adūre, rammaṃ sutitthañca mahodikañca;
segments.ja514:21.3: Sampupphitaṃ bhamaragaṇānuciṇṇaṃ, yattha hi so nhāyati nāgarājā.
segments.ja514:22.1: Disvāna nāgassa gatiṃ ṭhitiñca, vīthissa yā nhānagatassa hoti;
segments.ja514:23.1: Khaṇitvāna kāsuṃ phalakehi chādayi, attānamodhāya dhanuñca luddo;
segments.ja514:24.1: Viddho ca nāgo koñcamanādi ghoraṃ, sabbe ca [sabbeva (sī. syā. pī.)] nāgā ninnaduṃ [ninnādu (syā.), ninnādaṃ (ka.)] ghorarūpaṃ;
segments.ja514:24.3: Tiṇañca kaṭṭhañca raṇaṃ [cuṇṇaṃ (ka. sī. pī.)] karontā, dhāviṃsu te aṭṭhadisā samantato.
segments.ja514:25.3: Dukkhena phuṭṭhassudapādi saññā, arahaddhajo sabbhi avajjharūpo.
segments.ja514:26.1: Anikkasāvo kāsāvaṃ, yo vatthaṃ paridahissati [paridahessati (sī. pī.), paridhassati (katthaci)];
segments.ja514:28.3: Kimatthayaṃ kissa vā samma hetu, mamaṃ vadhī kassa vāyaṃ payogo.
segments.ja514:29.1: Kāsissa rañño mahesī bhadante, sā pūjitā rājakule subhaddā;
segments.ja514:29.3: Taṃ addasā sā ca mamaṃ asaṃsi, dantehi atthoti ca maṃ [atthoti mamaṃ (syā. ka.)] avoca.
segments.ja514:30.1: Bahū hi me dantayugā uḷārā, ye me pitūnañca [pitunnampi (pī.)] pitāmahānaṃ;
segments.ja514:30.3: Jānāti sā kodhanā rājaputtī, vadhatthikā veramakāsi bālā.
segments.ja514:31.1: Uṭṭhehi tvaṃ ludda kharaṃ gahetvā, dante ime chinda purā marāmi;
segments.ja514:31.3: Vajjāsi taṃ kodhanaṃ rājaputtiṃ,“nāgo hato handa imassa dantā”.
segments.ja514:32.1: Uṭṭhāya so luddo kharaṃ gahetvā, chetvāna dantāni gajuttamassa;
segments.ja514:32.3: Vaggū subhe appaṭime pathabyā, ādāya pakkāmi tato hi khippaṃ.
segments.ja514:33.1: Bhayaṭṭitā [bhayadditā (sī. pī.)] nāgavadhena aṭṭā, ye te nāgā aṭṭha disā vidhāvuṃ;
segments.ja514:33.3: Adisvāna [adisva (sī. pī.)] posaṃ gajapaccamittaṃ, paccāgamuṃ yena so nāgarājā.
segments.ja514:34.1: Te tattha kanditvā roditvāna [roditva (sī. pī.)] nāgā, sīse sake paṃsukaṃ okiritvā;
segments.ja514:34.3: Agamaṃsu te sabbe sakaṃ niketaṃ, purakkhatvā mahesiṃ sabbabhaddaṃ.
segments.ja514:35.1: Ādāya dantāni gajuttamassa, vaggū subhe appaṭime pathabyā;
segments.ja514:35.3: Suvaṇṇarājīhi samantamodare, so luddako kāsipuraṃ upāgami;
segments.ja514:35.5: Upanesi so rājakaññāya dante, nāgo hato handa imassa dantā.
segments.ja514:36.1: Disvāna dantāni gajuttamassa, bhattuppiyassa purimāya jātiyā;
segments.ja514:36.3: Tattheva tassā hadayaṃ aphāli, teneva sā kālamakāsi bālā.
segments.ja514:37.1: Sambodhipatto sa [ca (sī. syā.), va (pī.)] mahānubhāvo, sitaṃ akāsi parisāya majjhe;
segments.ja514:37.3: Pucchiṃsu bhikkhū suvimuttacittā, nākāraṇe pātukaronti buddhā.
segments.ja514:38.1: Yamaddasātha dahariṃ kumāriṃ, kāsāyavatthaṃ anagāriyaṃ carantiṃ;
segments.ja514:38.3: Sā kho tadā rājakaññā ahosi, ahaṃ tadā nāgarājā ahosiṃ.
segments.ja514:39.1: Ādāya dantāni gajuttamassa, vaggū subhe appaṭime pathabyā;
segments.ja514:39.3: Yo luddako kāsipuraṃ upāgami, so kho tadā devadatto ahosi.
segments.ja514:40.1: Anāvasūraṃ cirarattasaṃsitaṃ, uccāvacaṃ [ucaṃ nīcaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] caritamidaṃ purāṇaṃ;
segments.ja514:40.3: Vītaddaro vītasoko visallo, sayaṃ abhiññāya abhāsi buddho.
segments.ja514:41.1: Ahaṃ vo tena kālena, ahosiṃ tattha bhikkhavo;
segments.ja514:41.3: Nāgarājā tadā homi [hosiṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], evaṃ dhāretha jātakanti.
